title: Forbes Features Bond’s Groundbreaking Personal Security Platform
summary: Personal security for everyone in every situation. Whether you're uneasy or in danger, Bond is only a tap away. Our technology, services and Personal Security Agents are available 24/7.
body_markdown:
On the heels of the rapid growth and widespread adoption of the Bond Personal Security platform, Forbes.com has published an article on the innovative service featuring interviews with Bond member[Hazel Carrasquillo](https://www.ourbond.com/bond-member-story-famous-hazel/) and Bond CEO, Doron Kempel.


-


> “Thanks[Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/davidjeans/2020/09/11/this-ex-israeli-commando-is-betting-16-million-of-his-own-money-that-people-will-use-his-app-rather-than-calling-the-cops/#1fc70afd981d) for the David Jeans article on Bond’s transformational platform and mission of personal security. We diligently maintain data privacy for members; and are grateful to the irreplaceable police/medics whom we orchestrate in emergencies.” — *Bond CEO, Doron Kempel*
